title: Session Reduction Study

optimistic.description: All levers confirmed + all high-confidence applied. 3-track parallel (E+F+EW). Replace-vs-repair + factory model boost.
optimistic.achievable: Plausible with ideal execution, no rework, sustained 15 items/session

expected.description: DL-008 removed, modernization deferred, E/F partially parallelized, governance batched.
expected.achievable: Realistic target. Assumes standard execution cadence.

conservative.description: DL-008 removed, modernization deferred. No parallelization. Sequential E then F.
conservative.achievable: Safe floor. Can be achieved with simple sequential execution.

recommended: Plan for EXPECTED (17 sessions). Reserve capacity for CONSERVATIVE (22 sessions). Celebrate if OPTIMISTIC (14 sessions).
